author: jdm204
body: TCF4 (the bHLH TF) is listed as enabling beta-catenin binding with PMID:29739711 listed as the reference, but that 2018 paper calls TCF7L2 "TCF4" - the antibody they use (Santa Cruz Biotechnology, SC-8631) is against the gene product of TCF7L2.
title: Annotation in error: TCF4 (P15884) listed as enabling beta-catenin binding (GO:0008013), publication refers to TCF7L2

author: ValWood
body:
@jdm204 thanks for the feedback.

Hi @RLovering  could you fix?
Thanks
v

author: RLovering
body:
Hi Val

this is a SWIE annotation. Made by Antonia. 
In the TCF4 P2G record I had previously added an alert as this protein is often confused with TCF7L2 
Antonia please would you fix @Antonialock 

All the best to you both

Ruth

author: Antonialock
body: well it's an annotation I modified for some reason or other! It looks like the original curator annotated TCF7L2 in swiss-prot, so I will just update the P2GO annotation. Thanks for reporting
